Flow.description: When a Survey Response is created or the CSAT Score or CSAT Comments updated, update the related Contact's "Most Recent CSAT Score" and "Most Recent CSAT Comments" fields. Must run after flow - SurveyResponse_CreateLookupRelationships - because it relies on the Contact lookup relationship established in that flow. S3P-785
Flow.label: SurveyResponse_Contact_UpdateMostRecentCSATScoreAndComments

recordUpdates.description: On the related contact record, update "Most Recent CSAT Score" and "Most Recent CSAT Score Comments".
recordUpdates.name: Update_Contact_Most_Recent_CSAT_Score_and_Comments
recordUpdates.label: Update Contact Most Recent CSAT Score and Comments
